scheme_name: Technical Education Scholarship Scheme for ITI Level
other_conditions: Must be studying in ITIs or ITIs for women in Himachal Pradesh.
Must belong to SC, ST, or OBC categories for the entire training period.
Must not have unauthorized absence during the second half of training.
Must maintain attendance of at least 80% during training.
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹250 per month per trainee, reduced if the trainee receives any other stipend.
